body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: ca5a6826b80c75d0973852f04e8eff43b624758c -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a safety review because the change controls posted cutting moves.

- Each unsupported COMP record gives a warning with the operation name.
- The refusal stops later cuts. SECTION and COMP OFF cannot clear it.
- Section end still cuts a threaded wire. The next plain section can post.
- The decision on issue #1498 and the decision file agree. Control offsets and same-path skim passes remain unsupported.

I built and tested locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-1913`. The trial merge with `upstream/main` at `6f8b309dcea9ea2c367ecfa53261ed140881bab3` had no conflicts. I did not use a GitHub runner.

`cargo test -p camcraft-post --no-run` passed.
`cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.
`git diff --check` passed.

The gate dry run included unrelated main changes because the trial merge was not committed. I ran the 28 suites selected for the PR files, one at a time, with `cargo test -j 6 -p <crate> --test <suite> -- --test-threads=6`. All 212 tests passed. No test failed or was ignored.

I repeated three mutations with temporary copies of the post. I used the local post CLI and the same input and output checks as the named tests. The PR files were not changed. Each original copy passed. Each changed copy failed the required check. Each restored copy passed.

| Mutation | Check | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Remove `!controlOffset` from section start | No G01 or T91 after COMP before SECTION; left/right, control/wear | Green / red / green |
| Remove `sectionOk = false` from the compensation hook | Keep the first cut and T90, but stop the later cut; left/right, control/wear | Green / red / green |
| Remove the section-end `controlOffset` reset | The next plain section must emit its two cuts, T91 and T90 once | Green / red / green |

Requested changes: none.

Notes: No golden file changed. The `.nc` and `.cl` diff is empty. The existing Sodick golden and skim-refusal tests passed. No UI file changed, so before/after screenshots are not required. No dependency, build script, workflow, or process file changed. No physical control was tested.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- review-cost: ca5a6826b80c75d0973852f04e8eff43b624758c -->
Tier: full review under the safety floor (posted G-code refusal; issue #1498 effort:max, worker tier high). No escalation.
Cost: 116,222 tokens · 24 tool calls · 35 min wall clock.
The review built locally. The camcraft-post suite passed with all seven sodick_comp pins. The app post suites that embed the changed script passed (33 tests). Clippy is clean for camcraft-post. One guard was mutation-checked: the section-end reset.
